yt.title: The sunlight you see left the Sun {c_stat} ago #Shorts
yt.description:
Average Earth-Sun distance: 1 astronomical unit = 149,597,870,700 m (IAU 2012). Speed of light: 299,792,458 m/s (SI). Travel time: {c_secs} s. Moon: mean distance 384,400 km, about {c_moon} s.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: When you see the Sun, you are not seeing it as it is right now.

scenes.label: for light to travel from the Sun to Earth
scenes.narration: Its light takes {c_say} to cross the average distance of about one hundred fifty million kilometers.
Light is the fastest thing there is, almost three hundred thousand kilometers every second. Space is just that big.
Moonlight is only about {c_moon_say} seconds old. How old is the light from the stars you saw last night?
